body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade, or one short stretch of trades, says nothing about a strategy. In testing about two trades in three lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Framing and live starts

The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. The live records for the engines start on different dates. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing about two trades in three lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. Framing: Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## Open positions on paper

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. ATOM is no longer open, because it exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. The open NEAR position is the only open position named in this record outside the three engines' paper books. Every position here is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Closed trades so far

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade, so that engine's average is null rather than a number. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. Those closed-trade averages are what the paper record shows so far. They are not a forecast of what comes next. The record is paper, and the engines' own state is read from the running record.

## Market filter and nearest breakouts

For trend-daily-v005 the Bitcoin market filter is off. For trend-daily-v006 the Bitcoin market filter is off. Each of those two engines shows 0 positions open on paper. The names closest to their 20-day breakout are the same for both engines. ZECUSDT is 4.65% below its high. UNIUSDT is 5.26% below its high. BNBUSDT is 8.38% below its high. These distances are measured against the 20-day breakout level, and the record lists only these three names as closest. The filter state and the open-position counts are part of the same snapshot.

## Where to check the same numbers

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-08T02:44:13.722Z. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status are the places to check for the current state of the paper record. Framing: Paper signals only.
